mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 1.5% for three consecutive months reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the 10-year Treasury yield below 2.5% for at least 60 days indicates a flattening yield curve that compresses discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in flattening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs for three consecutive months signals a strong labor market, which increases consumer demand and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strong labor periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% for at least 60 days indicates a tight labor market, which compresses discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in low unemployment periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) above 100,000 units for three consecutive months indicates robust consumer demand, which compresses discount rates and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in retail demand acceleration are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105,000 for three consecutive months indicates weak supply-side growth, which compresses discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in industrial production weakening are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 0.2% for three consecutive months indicates disinflation, which reduces policy rate cuts and compresses discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in low inflation periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in job openings (RSAFS) above 400,000 for three consecutive months indicates a strong labor market, which compresses discount rates and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in high job openings periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
